entities.summary: Izabella Yaylyan is a female weightlifter born on January 4th, 1995 in Yerevan, Armenia. In 2021, she represented Armenia at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan. She finished in 7th place in the women's 59 kg event. She won the bronze medal in the women's 55 kg event at the 2023 European Weightlifting Championships held in Yerevan, Armenia.
